lesson: The system is consistently failing to distinguish between localized liquidity sweeps and genuine trend reversals, resulting in entries during high-volatility distribution phases. By prioritizing short-term EMA alignments over the broader bearish market structure, the model is consistently entering on the wrong side of the Wyckoff distribution cycle.
adjustment: Implement a mandatory 'Trend Filter' that prohibits any long entries unless price is trading above the 200-day EMA, regardless of short-term structure.
methodology_flag: Trust Wyckoff distribution analysis more; trust short-term EMA alignment less.
